Generated by scripts/make_cedar.py from the committed fhgff3.json bytes, source schema SHA-256: 20ce320f5d706f11ed21cdece4dfb56e3568b50be126e25b4016f46f2e8e416c; do not hand edit. propertyDescriptions.annotationProtocol: Annotation protocol or workflow reference URI.
propertyDescriptions.annotationSoftware: Software that produced or processed the annotation.
propertyDescriptions.checksum: sha2-512/256 checksum value for hashing. Computed by `bioheaders combine` over the exact file bytes; never write or edit a checksum by hand.
propertyDescriptions.completeness: BUSCO completeness of the annotation, as counts.
propertyDescriptions.derivedFrom: Parent FAIR-bioHeaders files, by checksum. An item with header type FHR and relationship annotates is the annotated genome (at most one). At most one derivedFrom item may use relationship annotates, and then only with headerType FHR; the form does not enforce this, `bioheaders validate` does.
propertyDescriptions.featureCounts: Number of features of each type in the file, as asserted by the producer.
propertyDescriptions.genomeReference: The annotated genome given by its assembly accession and sequence collection digest, when it is not linked by FHR checksum. An identity asserted by the producer, never a checksum link (FR-006). The contract requires either genomeReference or a derivedFrom item with relationship annotates on an FHR parent; supply at least one (docs/FHGFF3.md).
propertyDescriptions.reuseConditions: Reuse conditions or license for the annotation.
propertyDescriptions.schema: URL of the FHGFF3 JSON Schema this record follows (raw-main, a release's raw tag URL or its w3id URL; docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md); it identifies the header type (FR-010). This template fixes the FHGFF3 contract URL to the released v0.5.0 version (https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/fhgff3/v0.5.0); docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md allows other URLs for existing records.
propertyDescriptions.schemaVersion: Version of the FHGFF3 schema contract ("MAJOR.MINOR"); 1.1 (extension fields) from v0.5.
propertyDescriptions.scholarlyArticle: Scholarly article where the annotation was published. A registered DOI without the resolver prefix (for example 10.5281/zenodo.6762550).
propertyDescriptions.soVersion: Sequence Ontology release used for the feature types, as its data-version (for example 2026-08-07).
propertyDescriptions.source: Sources of the annotation that are not FAIR-bioHeaders files, such as an annotation release or evidence set, as asserted by the producer; never verified by checksum.
propertyDescriptions.taxon: Species name and URL of the species information at identifiers.org.
